what: independent re-renders of the frozen reference profile, compared byte for byte. A clip that does not reproduce is not frozen.
independent: each run is a separate `tools/refprofile.py --render` process: the VST3 bundle is reloaded and the rig re-qualified every time. The machine, OS, plugin build, sample rate and block size are NOT varied and no claim is made about them.
workdir: (a session scratchpad; the per-run profiles and logs are not evidence, the hashes are)
exit_meaning: 0 every run agreed with every other run AND with the committed profile; 1 either two runs disagreed (not reproducible) or the runs agreed with each other and differed from the committed profile (drift, #156); 2 no render could be attempted
why_this_file_is_here: #164 repaired filt_corner but could only rescore OUR side: refprofile/cache/ is gitignored and was absent on that host, so the frozen Surge clips could not be read and every reference-side number was a no-verdict. This host re-rendered the cache and reproduced all sixteen committed sha256es, which is what makes the reference half of F1A/F1B/F1C measurable here at all -- and makes it the SAME reference #146 measured, not merely a reference this host agrees with itself about. refprofile/profile.json is unchanged by this run, which is the diff that says so.
